test_title: PYST 67: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six Roman numbers I, II, III, IV, V and VI are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the Roman number on the face opposite to 'VI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f19ae9f65e5b1e3f646fa101345e47896331fcba58ccf3a9421b850d535c57e4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As III and V are common on both the dices, it is clear that the remaining i.e. VI will be opposite to II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75babd40c0e928cbcebdc9d8e18e3eac7b2ff002fc8e76d542426cdd77843df8.png] 

So, the opposite side of "VI" will be side "II".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
